overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a focused and highly engaged professional online presence across LinkedIn, Bluesky, and Mastodon, totaling 3,580 followers. His content primarily centers around academic research, computational social science methods, software tools (CooRnet), and career/recruitment opportunities in disinformation and coordinated behavior studies.

contentThemes.description: Posts focused on research findings, tool releases (CooRnet v2.0), and conference presentations regarding information operations.
Announcements regarding grants, postdoctoral hiring, and PhD student recruitment in computational social science.
Insights and conversations around computational methods and platform study frameworks.

recommendations: Cross-promote major research milestones across all three platforms simultaneously to maximize reach.
Increase posting frequency on LinkedIn, as it holds the largest follower base (1,850) and generates high absolute engagement numbers.
Utilize interactive elements like call-to-actions or discussion prompts on Mastodon and Bluesky to further boost conversation and repost counts.

platformInsights.bluesky: Highest overall engagement rate (~6.14%) with strong amplification through reposts, particularly for new research paper announcements and student opportunities.
platformInsights.mastodon: Niche audience focused on technical tools and methodology, showing good engagement on tool release updates like CooRnet v2.0.
platformInsights.linkedin: Largest network producing the highest absolute likes and comments, performing exceptionally well for institutional news such as grant awards and job postings.
